home.hero.badge: Open protocol · No registration · End-to-end encrypted
home.hero.desc: Sign for desktop dApps with your mobile wallet. Scan to connect — no browser wallet, and no new app to install; use the wallet you already have.
home.features.title: Why Remote Inject
home.feature.noRegistration.title: No Registration
home.feature.noRegistration.desc: No API keys, project IDs, or accounts. Install and pair by scanning a QR code.
home.feature.keysOnPhone.title: Keys Stay on Your Phone
home.feature.keysOnPhone.desc: Signing happens in your mobile wallet. The extension never holds keys or seed material.
home.feature.encrypted.title: End-to-End Encrypted
home.feature.encrypted.desc: ChaCha20-Poly1305 over the WalletPair protocol. The relay sees connection metadata, but never your plaintext or keys.
home.feature.anyDapp.title: Works on Any dApp
home.feature.anyDapp.desc: Injects a standard EIP-1193 / EIP-6963 provider — Uniswap, Aave, Polymarket, and more.
home.how.title: How It Works
home.how.desc: The extension opens an encrypted channel on the relay and shows a QR code. You open the Remote Inject bridge page inside your mobile wallet, compare a four-digit code, and every request is signed by your wallet and returned — the relay never sees your data.
home.start.title: Get Started
home.start.desc: Install the extension on desktop, then open the bridge page in any mobile wallet with a built-in dApp browser.
home.step1.title: 1. Install
home.step1.desc: Load the extension from GitHub Releases into Chrome.
home.step2.title: 2. Scan & Compare
home.step2.desc: Scan the QR with your mobile wallet, confirm the four-digit code.
home.step3.title: 3. Use Any dApp
home.step3.desc: Open any dApp — signing happens on your phone.
home.protocol.title: Built on an Open Protocol
home.protocol.desc: Remote Inject implements the WalletPair protocol unchanged — an open spec for pairing, encryption, and EVM messaging, whose pairing and encryption core is formally verified in ProVerif. Use the public relay or self-host your own.
